# Web3Chess (https://web3chess.online)

> The premier skill-based chess arena and Telegram chess bot. Play chess online inside Telegram or web browser, solve free tactical puzzles, train against Stockfish 16 AI, and challenge opponents in optional USDT crypto matches with instant on-chain settlements.

## Core Features & Offerings

- **Telegram Chess Bot & Mini App**: Play chess directly inside Telegram with zero downloads or registration friction. Instant matchmaking across 120+ countries.
- **Real-Money USDT Chess Matches**: Real-stakes PvP chess. Both players stake equal USDT (1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250 USDT). Winner takes 95% of the pot with automated escrow.
- **100% Free Chess Academy & Tactics**: 100 tactical levels, interactive board vision puzzles, opening traps, and endgame training.
- **Stockfish 16 Engine Practice**: Unlimited free games against the Stockfish 16 chess engine with server-side validation and lag-compensated FIDE clocks.
- **Instant Non-Custodial Withdrawals**: Settle match winnings in seconds on GRAM rails with HMAC nonce bot confirmation.
- **Fair Play & Anti-Cheat Engine**: Real-time Stockfish correlation analysis, tamper-proof clocks, and anti-smurf matchmaking.

## Primary Pages & URLs

- [Play Chess Online / Telegram Bot](https://web3chess.online/play): Launch the Telegram chess bot or play in desktop web browser.
- [How to Play Chess in Telegram](https://web3chess.online/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide to starting games, inviting friends via Telegram chat, and match rules.
- [Play Chess for Money / USDT Stakes](https://web3chess.online/wagers): Transparent mathematical breakdown of 95% winner pot, rake rules, and bankroll management.
- [Free Chess Puzzles & Tactics Academy](https://web3chess.online/academy): Solve 100 interactive tactical levels and practice against Stockfish AI.
- [Fair Play & Anti-Cheat Rules](https://web3chess.online/fair-play): Server-side move validation, tamper-proof clocks, and anti-engine policies.
- [Chess Strategy & Tactics Guides](https://web3chess.online/blog): In-depth guides on Arabian mate, smothered mate, Blackburne-Shilling gambit, blitz time management, and Zwischenzug tactics.
